brief:
The Martyrs, Wounded and Prisoners Affairs Office, through spokesman Al-Fakhouri, condemned Israeli forces for forcing female detainees at Damoun prison to remove their headscarves and assaulting them, Shehab Wire reported. The office called for an urgent investigation into the violations and demanded international protection for the prisoners.

The incident marks the latest allegation of mistreatment against Palestinian women held in Israeli detention facilities. Officials have requested intervention from international bodies to safeguard detainees' dignity and rights.
